scope.exclusion_reason: Golden exchange is infeasible with the supplied payment state.

experiments.label: Baseline
experiments.hypothesis: Establish outcome performance and reveal policy-compliance blind spots.
experiments.conclusion: Outcome reward overstates compliance because hidden trajectory violations are not scored.

experiments.label: Long improved
experiments.change: Adds completion, request-ledger, conditional availability, informed confirmation, write-safety, transition, and structured-selection rules.
experiments.hypothesis: Explicit operational checks should improve completion and reduce unsafe trajectories.
experiments.conclusion: Best completion and read accuracy, but action legality and write matching do not improve.

experiments.label: Short execution
experiments.change: Replaces the long operational checklist with READ → CHECK → SUMMARIZE → WAIT FOR APPROVAL → EXECUTE → VERIFY.
experiments.hypothesis: A compact sequence should be easier for the agent to follow consistently.
experiments.conclusion: Strong cardinality improvement, but completion, DB matching, read accuracy, and unsafe-write prevalence regress.

experiments.label: Next-action override
experiments.change: Keeps the long prompt and adds a 631-character override for execution immediately after approval and post-item-modification plan pruning.
experiments.hypothesis: A precise post-approval rule should reduce repeated confirmation and invalid state transitions.
experiments.conclusion: Improves cardinality, legality, and state preconditions, but loses completion and increases missing-confirmation findings.

milestones.title: Baseline trajectories consolidated
milestones.detail: Seventy GPT-4.1 retail text trajectories were consolidated from 10, 10, and 50 task batches; task 105 was quarantined from analysis.

milestones.title: Outcome scoring blind spots identified
milestones.detail: Final database state and natural-language assertions allowed unsafe intermediate actions and policy violations to pass. ACTION was absent from all 69 analyzed reward bases.

milestones.title: Independent grader dimensions defined
milestones.detail: Call cardinality, unsafe write turns, and semantic action legality were separated because they answer different questions and intentionally overlap.

milestones.title: Hybrid evaluator implemented
milestones.detail: Two deterministic turn-level checks and one structured GPT-4.1 write-legality judge were added, persisted diagnostically in RewardInfo, unit-tested, and backfilled.

milestones.title: Legality/cardinality contamination corrected
milestones.detail: Cardinality-only wrong_sequence judgments were normalized out of action legality; parser contradictions are rejected.

milestones.title: Prompt experiments benchmarked
milestones.detail: Baseline, long improved, short execution, and next-action variants were run on the same 70 IDs with the same model, temperature, and seed.

evaluator_extensions.label: Tool-call cardinality
evaluator_extensions.purpose: Detect violations of the one-tool-call-per-turn retail policy independently of action safety.

evaluator_extensions.label: Unsafe write turn
evaluator_extensions.purpose: Detect batched mutations and attempted writes rejected by the database; count each turn once.

evaluator_extensions.label: Action legality
evaluator_extensions.definition: Permitted by policy and pre-action state, authorized by the user, and bound to the intended entity and arguments.
evaluator_extensions.purpose: Catch database-permitted but policy-illegal writes, conditional-intent failures, confirmation gaps, and state errors.
